About Crease

Crease is a free daily puzzle game about folding a strip of numbers. It has no accounts, no sign-up and no tracking of what you do in the game.

How the puzzles are made

Each day's puzzle is generated from the date by a program. The program picks a random strip, folds it a few times to make the target, then runs a solver to confirm the puzzle can be solved in exactly that many folds and has very few solutions. Every player gets the same puzzle on the same date.

Contact

Questions or bug reports: the site owner (add a contact email by setting CONTACT_EMAIL when you build).
